subject: Operations
title: The Mars Climate Orbiter
description: A quick, practical guide to The Mars Climate Orbiter.

hook.text: NASA lost a $125 million spacecraft because one team used metric and another imperial. A unit conversion error.

buildup.text: The Mars Climate Orbiter launched in 1998 to study the Martian atmosphere from orbit.

discovery.text: Lockheed Martin sent thruster data in pound-seconds. NASA's software expected newton-seconds. Nobody checked.

twist.text: The orbiter flew too close to Mars and burned up in the atmosphere. A simple handoff error destroyed the mission.

climax.text: NASA reformed its verification processes and made unit-checking mandatory across all contractor interfaces.

punchline.text: A $125 million lesson: always check the units.
